f.title: Foreign medical devices and regenerative products: known deaths and serious cases are no longer 30-day reports
f.statement: From 1 May 2026 the 30-day malfunction reporting of known (expected) deaths and serious cases for medical devices and regenerative medicine products no longer covers cases caused by foreign medical devices and foreign regenerative medicine products (amendment of the Enforcement Regulations by MHLW Ordinance No. 117 of 2025, reflected in the notice).

f.title: Foreign medical devices and regenerative products: expected deaths and serious cases with an unpredictable or changed trend within 15 days
f.statement: Report within 15 days deaths or serious cases suspected to be caused by a malfunction of a foreign medical device or foreign regenerative medicine product that are predictable from the precautions for use but whose occurrence trend cannot be predicted, or whose change in occurrence trend indicates a risk of occurrence or spread of harm to public health.

rows.quote_en: Among occurrences of deaths or serious cases etc. suspected to be the effect of a malfunction of a foreign medical device or foreign regenerative medicine product, those that are predictable from the precautions for use etc. but whose occurrence trend cannot be predicted, or whose change in occurrence trend indicates a risk of occurrence or spread of harm to public health, are to be reported within 15 days.

f.title: Treat deaths suspected to be due to an adverse reaction as reportable deaths
f.statement: A "death suspected to be caused by an adverse reaction of the drug" means a case in which the reason for death is suspected to be an adverse reaction of the drug.

rows.actor: MAH or foreign special-approval holder (製造販売業者等)
rows.quote: ア  「死亡の発生のうち、当該医薬品の副作用によるものと疑われるもの」とは、死亡した理由が、当該医薬品の副作用によるものと疑われる症例を指すものであること。

rows.quote_en: "Among occurrences of death, those suspected to be caused by an adverse reaction of the drug" means cases in which the reason for death is suspected to be an adverse reaction of the drug.

f.title: Treat a case as suspected unless causality can be ruled out (unknown causality included)
f.statement: "Suspected to be caused by an adverse reaction" covers everything except cases where a causal relationship can be ruled out; cases with unknown causality are included.

rows.actor: MAH or foreign special-approval holder (製造販売業者等)
rows.quote: イ  「副作用によるものと疑われるもの」とは、因果関係が否定できるもの以外のものを指し、因果関係が不明なものも含まれること。
rows.review_note: Review: definition that sets the causality threshold for reporting. Translation check: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: "Suspected to be caused by an adverse reaction" means anything other than cases in which a causal relationship can be denied, and includes cases in which the causal relationship is unknown.

f.title: Foreign drug: same-ingredient products used abroad, including investigational products and different routes or indications
f.statement: A "foreign drug" (drug used abroad recognised as having the same ingredients) is any product used abroad, including products under clinical trial, whose ingredients are the same as the drug, even if the route of administration, dosage, indications or effects differ.

rows.actor: MAH or foreign special-approval holder (製造販売業者等)
rows.quote: ウ 「当該医薬品と成分が同一性を有すると認められる外国で使用されている医朱ih (以下「外国医薬品」という。)」とは、外国で使用されている物 (治験中の物を含む。) であって、 当該医薬品と成分が同一のものを指し、 投与経路、 用法、 用量、効能、効果等が異なる場合も含まれるものであること。

f.title: Report at least the foreign cases that must be reported urgently to the government of the country where they occurred
f.statement: Whether a case that occurred abroad is reportable is judged under Art 228-20(1)(i) of the Enforcement Regulations, but at least those cases that must be reported urgently to the government of the country where the case occurred should be reported.

f.title: Unexpected (未知): not in the precautions for use, or nature, severity or specificity differs; listed but unpredictable serious cases are 15-day reports
f.statement: "Not predictable from the necessary precautions for use" (unexpected, 未知) means not described in the precautions for use of the package-insert information (warnings, important precautions, interactions, adverse reactions etc.), or described but with nature, severity or specificity not consistent with the description. A serious case that could not be predicted from the existing description is a 15-day report even if the adverse reaction is listed.

rows.actor: MAH or foreign special-approval holder (製造販売業者等)
rows.deadline: Within 15 days (listed but unpredictable serious cases)
rows.quote: エ 「使用上の必要な注意等から予測することができないもの」とは、注意事項等情報における 「使用上の注意」(「入告」、「重要な基本的注意」、「相互作用」、「副作用」等) に記載されていないもの、あるいは、記載されていてもその人性質又は症状の程度、特異性等が記載内容と一致しないもの (以下「未知」という。) Cdること。例えば、副作用として「使用上の注意」に記載されていても、当該記載では予測できないような重篤例は、15 日以内の報告の対象でやること。
rows.review_note: Held below 90: OCR noise in the quoted passage (入告 for 警告, 人性質 for 性質, Cd ること and でやること for であること); the reading is clear from context and the parallel passages, but the quote is not a clean copy of the original.
rows.quote_en: "Not predictable from the necessary precautions for use etc." means those not described in the "Precautions for use" ("Warnings", "Important precautions", "Interactions", "Adverse reactions" etc.) in the package-insert information, or, even if described, whose nature, severity of symptoms, specificity etc. do not agree with the description (hereinafter "unknown"). For example, even if listed as an adverse reaction in the "Precautions for use", a serious case that could not be predicted from that description is subject to 15-day reporting.

f.title: Unpredictable occurrence trend: new interactions or a clear rise in frequency over the labelled frequency
f.statement: An occurrence trend (number, frequency, conditions of occurrence) "not predictable from the precautions for use" includes, for example, serious or new adverse reactions from a new interaction with a drug not described in the precautions, and a clear increase in frequency compared with the frequency described in the precautions.

rows.actor: MAH or foreign special-approval holder (製造販売業者等)
rows.quote: オ 「発生数、発生顔度、発生条件等の傾向 (以下「発生傾向」という。) を当該医楽品の使用上の必要な注意等から予測することができないもの」とは、当該医薬品の副作用の発生数、発生顔度、発生条件等の傾向が、使用上の必要な注意等から予測できないものを指すこと。 例えば、「使用上の注意」に記載のない医薬品との新たな相互作用により重篤な副作用や新たな副作用が発生した場合等が該当すること。また、「使用上の注意」に記載のある発生顔度に比べ、明らかに発生頻度が上昇している場合等も該当する。
rows.review_note: Held below 90: OCR noise in the quoted passage (顔度 for 頻度, 医\n楽品 for 医薬品); the reading is clear from context and the parallel passages, but the quote is not a clean copy of the original.
rows.quote_en: "Those whose trend in number, frequency, conditions of occurrence etc. ('occurrence trend') cannot be predicted from the necessary precautions for use of the drug" means those whose trend in the number, frequency, conditions etc. of occurrence of adverse reactions cannot be predicted from the precautions. For example, cases where a serious or new adverse reaction occurs through a new interaction with a drug not described in the "Precautions for use". Cases where the frequency has clearly risen compared with the frequency described in the "Precautions for use" also fall under this.

f.title: Keep shipment and estimated patient-use data available to judge whether a frequency was predictable
f.statement: To examine whether a frequency of occurrence could be predicted, it is desirable to collect shipment volumes, estimated numbers of patients using the drug etc. periodically, or at least to have an internal system that can obtain these data when needed.

rows.actor: MAH or foreign special-approval holder (製造販売業者等)
rows.quote: なお、発生顔度が予測できるか否か検討するために、定期的に出荷数、推定使用患者数等を把握するか、又は少なくとも必要な時に当該データを入手できるように社内体制を整えておくことが望ましいこと。

rows.quote_en: In order to examine whether the frequency of occurrence can be predicted, it is desirable to grasp the number of units shipped, the estimated number of patients using the product etc. periodically, or at least to have an internal system in place so that such data can be obtained when needed.

f.title: Trend change indicating risk: reportable at the latest once any safety measure is being considered
f.statement: Where the change in the occurrence trend of adverse reactions indicates a risk of occurrence or spread of harm to public health, the case is reportable at least from the time the MAH has started considering any safety assurance measure, such as revising the "Precautions for use" or alerting healthcare professionals.

rows.actor: MAH or foreign special-approval holder (製造販売業者等)
rows.quote: また、少なくとも「使用上の注意」の改訂や医薬関係者への注意喚起等の何らかの安全確保措置の検討を開始した場合には、報告の対象となるものであること。

f.title: Disability (障害): functional impairment that interferes with daily life
f.statement: "Disability" means the onset of functional impairment to a degree that interferes with daily life.

rows.actor: MAH or foreign special-approval holder (製造販売業者等)
rows.quote: キ 「障害」とは、日常生活に支障を来す程度の機能不全の発現を指すものであること。

rows.quote_en: "Disability" means the onset of functional impairment to an extent that interferes with daily life.

f.title: Drug with an active ingredient different from approved drugs: new active ingredient drugs, including same-ingredient approvals during reexamination
f.statement: A "drug whose active ingredient differs from already approved drugs" means a new active ingredient drug approved as such under the Fee Ordinance (Cabinet Order No. 91 of 2005), including drugs applied for and approved as having the same ingredient during the reexamination period of the new active ingredient drug.

rows.actor: MAH or foreign special-approval holder (製造販売業者等)
rows.quote: ク 「既承認医薬品と有効成分が異なる医薬品」 とは、 医薬品、 医療機器等の品質、有効性及び安全性の確保等に関する法律関係手数料令 (平成 17 年政令第 91 号)に規定する既承認医薬品と有効成分が異なる医薬品として承認された新有効成分含有医薬品 (新有効成分含有医薬品の再審査期間中に、その成分と同一性を有する医薬品として承認申請し、承認を受けたものを含む。) を指すこと。

rows.quote_en: "A drug whose active ingredient differs from already approved drugs" means a drug containing a new active ingredient approved as a drug whose active ingredient differs from already approved drugs as prescribed in the Cabinet Order on fees relating to the PMD Act (Cabinet Order No. 91 of 2005) (including a drug applied for and approved as having identity with that ingredient during the reexamination period of the new active ingredient drug).

f.title: EPPV cases: cases obtained through early post-marketing phase vigilance, including the indication under EPPV after an added indication
f.statement: Cases "obtained through early post-marketing phase vigilance" are cases suspected to be adverse reactions of the drug obtained through EPPV. For a drug under EPPV because of an added indication etc., adverse reaction cases arising from use for the indication under EPPV are reportable.

rows.actor: MAH or foreign special-approval holder (製造販売業者等)
rows.quote: ケ  「市販直後調査により得られたもの」とは、市販直後調査により得られた、当該医薬品の副作用によるものと疑われる症例を指すこと。また、効能追加等により市販直後調査を実施中の医薬品にあっては、当該市販直後調査の対象となる効能、効果等に係る使用により発生した副作用症例が報告の対象となること。
rows.review_note: Review: scope of item ホ. Translation check: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: "Those obtained through early post-marketing phase vigilance" means cases suspected to be caused by an adverse reaction of the drug obtained through EPPV. For a drug under EPPV because of an added indication etc., adverse reaction cases arising from use relating to the indications, effects etc. subject to that EPPV are subject to reporting.

f.title: Infections suspected to be due to the drug include pathogen contamination of biological products and viral marker seroconversion
f.statement: "Infection suspected to be caused by use of the drug" means, for biological products, cases where contamination of the drug by a pathogen from a raw material of biological origin is suspected (for example viral hepatitis or HIV infection suspected to be caused by a blood product). Seroconversion of viral markers such as HBV, HCV and HIV is also subject to infection reporting.

rows.actor: MAH or foreign special-approval holder (製造販売業者等)
rows.quote: コ 「当該医薬品の使用によるものと疑われる感染症」とは、生物由来製品において、生物由来の原料又は材料から、当該医薬品への病原体の混入が疑われる場合等を指すこと。例えば、血液製剤によるものと疑われるウイルス性肝炎、H I V感染等が該当する。また、HBV、HCV及びH I V等のウイルスマーカーの陽性化についても、感染症報告の対象となること。
rows.review_note: Review: OCR spacing in H I V only. Translation check: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: "Infection suspected to be caused by use of the drug" refers to cases etc. in which, for a biological product, contamination of the drug with a pathogen from raw materials or materials of biological origin is suspected. For example, viral hepatitis or HIV infection suspected to be caused by a blood product. Seroconversion of viral markers such as HBV, HCV and HIV is also subject to infection reporting.

f.title: Foreign safety measures include changes of indication, dosage or manufacturing, Dear Doctor letters and important label revisions
f.statement: Measures taken abroad that are reportable include, besides suspension of manufacture etc. for efficacy or safety reasons, changes to indications or effects, dosage and administration or manufacturing method, distribution of Dear Doctor letters and comparable important revisions of the "Precautions for use".
f.applicability: Measures taken abroad for foreign drugs

f.title: Risk of cancer or other serious disease: shown by epidemiological, animal, physical or chemical study results
f.statement: "A risk that cancer or other serious disease, disability or death may occur" means the onset or possibility of a serious disease caused by an adverse reaction of the drug or an infection from its use, shown by epidemiological reports, animal studies, physical or chemical tests etc., for example cancer, deafness or blindness.

rows.actor: MAH or foreign special-approval holder (製造販売業者等)
rows.quote: ア  「がんその他の重大な疾病、障害若しくは死亡が発生するおそれがあること」とは、疫学調査報告、動物等を用いた試験、物理的試験又は化学的試験の成績等により、当該医薬品の副作用又はその使用による感染症に起因する重大な疾病の発現又はその可能性を指すものであること。例えば、がん、難聴、失明等が該当するものであること。
rows.review_note: Review: definition for 30-day research reports. Translation check: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: "That there is a risk of cancer or other serious disease, disability or death occurring" means the onset, or the possibility, of a serious disease attributable to an adverse reaction of the drug or an infection from its use, based on the results of epidemiological study reports, tests using animals etc., physical tests or chemical tests etc. For example, cancer, deafness, blindness etc.

f.title: Significant change in occurrence trend: clear change in number, frequency, conditions or severity, including in strata
f.statement: A significant change in the occurrence trend of adverse reaction cases or infections of the drug or foreign drug means a clear change in number, frequency, conditions of occurrence, symptoms or severity; for example, where overall numbers change little but stratification shows a rise in a particular age group, complication or dosage.

rows.actor: MAH or foreign special-approval holder (製造販売業者等)
rows.quote: イ 「当該医薬品若しくは外国医薬品の副作用による症例等若しくはそれらの使用による成染症の発生傾向が著しく変化したこと」とは、当該医薬品及び外国医薬品について、副作用又は感染症の発生数、発生顔度、発生条件、症状又は程度等の明らかな変化を指すものであること。例えば、全体としての発生数、発生疾度の変化は大きくないが、層別してみた場合に特定の年齢、合併症、用法、用量等で特に発生数、発生顔度の上昇が判明 した場合等が、該当するものであること。

For example, where the change in overall number or frequency is not large but stratified analysis reveals a rise in number or frequency in a particular age, complication, dosage etc.

f.title: Lack of approved efficacy: shown by clinical or animal studies
f.statement: "Not having the approved indications or effects" means that clinical studies, animal studies etc. show that the drug or its active ingredient does not have the approved indication or effect.

rows.actor: MAH or foreign special-approval holder (製造販売業者等)

rows.quote_en: "Not having the approved indications or effects" means that, for the drug or its active ingredient, clinical studies, animal studies etc. show that it does not have the approved indications or effects.

rows.quote_en: "Research reports" means research reports published in domestic and foreign academic journals etc., and research reports of studies conducted by the company itself or related companies etc.

f.title: New drugs subject to reexamination: drugs with a reexamination obligation at approval
f.statement: "New drugs under Art 14-4(1)(i) of the Act and drugs instructed by the Minister under Art 14-4(1)(ii)" means drugs that were required to undergo reexamination at the time of approval.

rows.actor: MAH or foreign special-approval holder (製造販売業者等)
